ja: 先週末は雨がひどかったから、子どもたちには一日中家で好きなゲームをさせてあげたんだ。
en: The rain was so heavy last weekend that I let the kids play whatever games they wanted at home all day.
alternatives: It rained so hard last weekend that I let the kids play any games they liked at home all day.
Since it was pouring last weekend, I let my kids play whatever games they wanted at home all day long.
point: 「させてあげた」は let + 人 + 動詞の原形（to は不要）

ja: 新しい家の写真、見せてよ。
en: Show me some pictures of your new house.
alternatives: Show me some photos of your new place.
Show me a few pictures of your new house.
point: 複数の写真は pictures、漠然と「何枚か」なら some を付ける

ja: 天気予報では週末は雨だって言ってたのに、結局ずっと晴れてたね。
en: The forecast said it would rain this weekend, but it stayed sunny the whole time.
alternatives: The weather forecast said it was going to rain this weekend, but it was sunny the whole time.
They said it would rain this weekend, but it ended up being sunny all weekend.
point: said に合わせて will を would にする

ja: 先週教えてもらったカフェ、行ってみたよ。すごくよかった。
en: I went to the café you told me about last week. It was great.
alternatives: I tried the café that you told me about last week, and I loved it.
I checked out the café you recommended last week. It was really good.
point: told me about の about を落とさない

ja: 昨日君が電話くれたとき、私は犬と遊んでいたんだ。
en: I was playing with my dog when you called yesterday.
alternatives: I was playing with the dog when you called yesterday.
When you called yesterday, I was playing with my dog.
point: 「〜していた」は過去進行形 was + -ing

ja: 忙しかったけど、昔の友達に久しぶりに会えて、いい週末だったよ。
en: Although I was busy, I had a great weekend catching up with old friends.
alternatives: Even though I was busy, I had a great weekend catching up with old friends.
I was busy, but I had a nice weekend catching up with some old friends.
I was busy, but it was a good weekend because I got to see some old friends I hadn't seen in ages.
point: although の後に but は重ねない

ja: すごく日焼けしてるね。先週の連休は、どこか暖かいところに行ってたに違いないね。
en: You're really tanned. You must have gone somewhere warm over last week's long weekend.
alternatives: You've got a great tan. You must have been somewhere warm over the long weekend last week.
You're so tanned. You must have gone somewhere warm for last week's long weekend.
point: 過去の推量「〜したに違いない」は must have + 過去分詞

ja: 今年の夏は暑かっただけでなく、雨もほとんど降らなかった。
en: Not only was this summer hot, but we also hardly had any rain.
alternatives: Not only was it hot this summer, but it also barely rained at all.
It wasn't just hot this summer; it also hardly rained at all.
point: Not only が文頭なら was this summer と語順が逆になる

ja: 先週末に君が話してたカフェ、ついに行ってみたよ。もっと早く知っていればよかったなあ。
en: I finally tried that café you mentioned last weekend, and I wish I'd known about it much sooner.
alternatives: I finally went to the café you told me about last weekend, and I wish I'd found out about it sooner.
I finally checked out that café you mentioned last weekend. If only I'd known about it earlier!
point: 過去の後悔は I wish の後を過去完了 I'd known にする

ja: この前話した、隣に越してきたご夫婦が、先週末うちをバーベキューに誘ってくれたんだ。
en: The couple I told you about, the ones who moved in next door, invited us over for a barbecue last weekend.
alternatives: You know the couple who moved in next door that I mentioned? They invited us to a barbecue last weekend.
That couple who moved in next door, the ones I told you about, invited us to a barbecue last weekend.
point: 長い主語を関係節でまとめてから動詞 invited へ
